name: agent-brief
description: Links a Claude Code session to the Agent Brief panel: sketch, stack, write and track from the band or /sketch, /stack, /write and /track, with what you send delivered into the prompt. Also applies feedback sessions exported by the companion Chrome extension with /apply-feedback.

inboxDir.title: Inbox folder
inboxDir.description: Folder the extension drops zips into. Empty means ~/Downloads/feedback-inbox.

nodePath.title: Node binary
nodePath.description: Node used to run bin/ingest.mjs (Node 20 or newer).

transcriber.title: Transcriber
transcriber.description: yap uses macOS on-device speech. whisper uses whisper.cpp and needs a model path.

whisperModel.title: Whisper model
whisperModel.description: Path to a ggml model for whisper-cli, used when the transcriber is whisper.

companionSocket.title: Companion socket
companionSocket.description: Unix socket of the Agent Brief app. Empty means ~/Library/Application Support/AgentBrief/agent-brief.sock.

companionLaunch.title: Companion launch command
companionLaunch.description: Shell command (sh -c) that starts Agent Brief when /sketch finds it not running.
